label: Head CT with TBI lesions (BLAST-CT demo, 7.0 MB)
description: Non-contrast head CT with intraparenchymal and extra-axial haemorrhages, perilesional oedema, and intraventricular haemorrhage from the BLAST-CT repository (Apache-2.0).
expectedResult: Four-class native-space TBI lesion label map (~48.1 mL IPH, ~23.6 mL EAH, ~62.7 mL perilesional oedema, ~0.3 mL IVH) and per-class lesion volume CSV matching BLAST-CT v2.1.0 (v2 multi-centre model, checkpoint 1).
